duplicate_review.finding: No exact duplicate atom IDs or canonical statements detected in the merged set.

consistency_review.finding: Quantitative trial atoms are explicitly tagged secondary_reported_result and anchored to the review; no claim is presented as primary-study extraction.

extraction_limitations: This article is a narrative review. The LiteratureAtom model is designed primarily for primary literature, so review recommendations and secondary trial summaries are represented with author_conclusion/other or quantitative_result plus secondary-source tags.
References were excluded from ATOM extraction and were instead converted into a separate task queue for primary-source retrieval.
The review does not report a systematic search strategy, study-selection process, or formal risk-of-bias assessment.
Only source-supported context was populated; unreported denominators, confidence intervals, and trial details were not inferred.
schema_gaps: No dedicated atom kind exists for narrative-review synthesis or secondary-reported evidence; tags are used to preserve this distinction.
